summary.text: Explanation of the signs and abbreviations used for astronomical vocabulary, listing planetary names and symbols, the twelve zodiac signs, nodes, angles, aspects, degrees, lots, epicycle, sphere, and other astrological terms from Laurentian Codex XXVIII, 14, folio 309.
